notes.title: Patch Notes for Chiaro Halloween Update
notes.content:
Here are the bug fixes and improvements for Chiaro. 

Major Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where the player would spawn at the bottom of the Tree House in Chapter 2
- Fixed a crashing bug when completing Chapter 1
- Fixed an issue where the game would break at the end of Chapter 7 
- Fixed a bug where falling off the elevator in Chapter 9 wouldn't respawn the player in the right location, thus breaking the game
- Fixed a weird bug where falling off the cliff in Chapter 7 would grow the players hands, and the game would be unplayable

Minor Bug Fixes:
- Fixed issues where the player could end up making their way to underneath the map
- Player should spawn at the appropriate height in levels now
- Fixed a bug where Scoria would run on the spot in Chapter 10

Improvements
- Navigation improvements
- Reduced the Chapter 10 boss range of attack
- Improved the collisions of the Avalanche section in Chapter 6

If you do experience any bugs, please now report the bug here:

[url=https://forms.gle/ew1nezUNse6FBAoe9]Chiaro Bug Submission[/url]

notes.title: Chiaro is 25% off starting 10am, and movement options pushed!
notes.content:
G'day everyone,
We're doing a weeklong sale of 25% leading up to and through Halloween, so put on your pumpkin hat and say hello to Boka and the Gang! 

We have made a lot of updates to Chiaro recently and the game is playing better than ever. We still have a few small fixes to make with the new array of movement options available, but we hope you enjoy these changes and will continue working diligently to implement additional customizations.

Martov Co

notes.title: Smooth Locomotion now available *IN BETA!*
notes.content:
We're happy to announce we have pushed a big [b]SMOOTH LOCOMOTION[/b] update to Chiaro, including several comfort options, speed settings, smooth turning and controller directed movement. We would love feedback on this feature from Vive, Oculus, and Windows MR players. ːsteamhappyː

Additionally, in this beta you will find that we have opened up some of the exterior environments and removed some of the aggressive invisible wall blocking to give you more freedom to relax and explore the world of Neverain whereever your curiosity leads you. We hope you enjoy this added sense of freedom!

Please post feedback here or visit us in Discord to chat with us about the feature, we are really eager to bring players worldwide the best possible version of smooth locomotion! [url=https://discord.gg/TYGBQRV]Chiaro Discord[/url]

notes.title: Chiaro coming tonight!
notes.content:
Hello all,

As you may see, Chiaro is listed for a September 13th release. We are quite confident we will make our release date at this point (and hopefully by 9 pm EST), but have had a few hiccups along the way.

If you'd like to come hang out while we get everything organized, you can come chat with us in the discord at https://discord.gg/CycNsGN .

Thank you for supporting Chiaro and The Elixir of Life! We are so excited to introduce you all to the magical world of Neverain.

Martin

notes.title: Taylor Gray is Chiaro in Chiaro and the Elixir of Life
notes.content:
As lifelong Star Wars fans, it's surreal and insanely exciting to make this official: Taylor Gray, who just completed an amazing journey as Ezra Bridger on [i]Star Wars Rebels[/i], will voice Chiaro, the character you will play as on your adventure. Taylor's performance elevates Chiaro to another level entirely and it was an honor to collaborate with him. 

We are excited to share more from the world of Chiaro and the Elixir of Life in the weeks ahead! :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31927778/581f07eeb690bc4fbf4a2d573082ba6558a1e214.png[/img]
